artist.name: The Big Fat Minimalist
artist.bio: The Big Fat Minimalist is the artist name of Aniruddh Mehta, a Mumbai-based designer and DJ who also plays as bigfat. His DJ sets explore dub music from roots reggae to meditative dubstep, and he hosted Control Sessions on boxout.fm, covering dub, dubstep, grime and reggae. He played Boxout Weekender 2018 in New Delhi.

eras.sound: Minimal, low-end dub and dubstep with roots reggae
